description: Model and runner routing for GitHub issues. Maintained by .claude/scripts/route-issue.ps1. Each issue is classified once and never reclassified automatically.
rules: v2 (2026-11-13): Claude writes all code, UI and tests; AGY writes prose only. See route-issue.ps1.
Opus (claude): severity:critical, OR (crypto OR sync) AND severity:high
Gemini (agy): [Docs]/[Spec] title or docs/documentation/spec-inconsistency label, with no domain label and not severity:high; its PR may only touch docs (agy-gate.ps1)

Merge (computed live, not stored): review = owner merges by hand, for labels crypto/sync/file-format/memory-hygiene/browser-integration/severity:critical/severity:high or titles [Crypto]/[Sync]/[File format]/[Memory hygiene]/[Keyfile]/[Duress]/[Distribution]/[Release]/[Updater]/[Signing]/[CI]/[Pipeline]/[Security]; auto otherwise. Pin with "merge": "auto"|"review" on an entry.
